text:
alex: opened a PR to modernize the hello-minima quickstart. switches examples from header-based REDWOOD-KEY to standard Authorization: Bearer <token> and renames env var to REDWOOD_TOKEN. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4601
priya: thanks — can you list the affected snippets? i'll run a sweep for broken examples in the learning path.
alex: python, js, and go snippets in /docs/quickstart/hello-minima plus the docker compose and k8s manifest examples. also updated the notes about token rotation.
ben: quick heads-up: some community samples still use REDWOOD_API_KEY in the repo examples directory. we should either update or leave a redirect note.
alex: i'd prefer update in place and add a small compat note in an appendix. less surprising for new users.
priya: running a grep now. found occurrences in /examples/community/chatbot/README.md and in an embed sample under /docs/embeddings/guide.md
ben: might want to keep the existing SDK one-liners working — current JS SDK still accepts `apiKey` option, while Go uses `Token` named param. did you change all three languages consistently?
alex: PR uses the idiomatic param names: JS: new Redwood({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN }), Py: Client(token=...), Go: client.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_TOKEN"))
priya: i tested the JS snippet locally (node 18) — linter errors flagged an unused import in the sample file. small fix added to the PR.
ci-bot: CI started for PR #4601  (lint, build, link-check)
doc-bot: note: content links flagged in /docs/quickstart/hello-minima — one external link 404, marking for followup.
alex: i'll patch the broken link in a follow-up commit, want to keep this PR focused on auth changes.
ben: CI failing on the Go snippet tests — compile error: `client.NewClient` expects a `Config{Token: ...}` struct in v0.9.0. our repo uses an older pattern. we should either change snippet to `client.NewClient(&client.Config{Token: os.Getenv("REDWOOD_TOKEN")})` or bump the example to v0.10.0.
alex: prefer not to force a version bump; i'll update the snippet to the struct form. pushing commit now.
priya: once that compiles locally i'll re-run the smoke. also updated the community examples with a note and opened #4602 to do the global replace to REDWOOD_TOKEN so we can track it separately.
ci-bot: re-run CI for #4601 triggered by push 
ci-bot: lint error: markdown style — list indentation in hello-minima README.
alex: fixing markdown nit now.
ci-bot: CI passed for #4601 (lint + build + link-check partial)
priya: smoke tested python & js snippets, docker-compose quickstart spins up and performs a sample generate. go sample compiles with the struct change.
ben: merged #4601 — left a small changelog entry in /docs/whats-new.md about Authorization header and env var rename.
alex: thanks! i'll open #4603 to add the migration appendix showing how to support old REDWOOD_API_KEY and the curl examples using previous header form.
doc-bot: reminder: update redirect rules for /getting-started/credentials to point to new doc after migration appendix lands.
alex: noted. closing this thread — will watch for any community reports after the deploy. :shipit:
priya: thanks everyone, great quick turnaround.
